name: Gnome, Deep (Svirfneblin)
subjectPrompt: A single adult svirfneblin scout from the Underdark, with a compact wiry deep-gnome build, slate-gray skin, prominent ears, a broad nose, and a shaved ground-gray head. His alert face is turned slightly to the side. He wears scuffed brown leather armor over a muted olive work tunic and dark blue trousers, thick miner's boots, rough brown gloves and a small leather pouch. He stands in an alert but relaxed three-quarter stance, lowering a modest metal war pick with a single pointed head. One hand rests on his belt. Use the reference for gnome proportions and slate skin, with a distinct face, pose and practical clothing. One complete figure, no other figures, no environment.

name: Succubus/Incubus
subjectPrompt: A companion study of one winged shapechanger shown in two classic fiend forms, side by side as distinct equally important full-length silhouettes. On the left, an adult feminine infernal emissary with a tidy dark copper braid, small swept horns, charcoal brocade high-collared jacket fastened to the neck, layered wine-red tailcoat, fitted opaque trousers and riding boots. On the right, an adult masculine infernal emissary with dark auburn hair, matching horns, a fitted high-neck burgundy and charcoal jacket, cuffed long sleeves, belt, opaque trousers and boots. Both wear full formal traveling outfits. Both have folded crimson bat wings and a thin pointed tail curling close to their own feet. One quietly studies the viewer, the other looks three-quarters to the side. Still, dignified poses, no personal contact or weapons. Use the two references only for horn, tail and wing anatomy, with original fully covering outfits and poses. Keep their silhouettes from overlapping, and make the two share a single blank parchment field without a frame or divider.
